message.content: 在大多數傳統撲克遊戲（例如德州撲克）中，每位玩家手中的紙牌數量是相同的——通常是兩張。唯一「多」的地方是桌面上的公共牌（稱為「翻牌」或「翻牌區」），它共有五張，供所有玩家共同使用。因此，如果從「誰持有最多紙牌」來看，答案是：**公共牌（桌面上的五張牌）比任何單一玩家手中的牌都多**。如果你只考慮玩家個人手牌，那麼每位玩家手中的牌數相等。

The user asks: "在撲克牌遊戲中，誰擁有最多的紙牌？" which translates to "In a poker game, who has the most cards?" They likely want an answer about the number of cards each player gets. In Texas Hold'em, each player gets two cards. But the question might be ambiguous: "who has the most cards?" In a standard poker game, each player gets the same number of cards. But maybe they refer to the dealer? Or the community cards? In Texas Hold'em, the dealer deals two cards to each player, and there are five community cards. So the dealer has no cards. The community cards are shared. So the question might be answered: In Texas Hold'em, each player gets two cards, and the community cards are five. So no one has more than two unless you consider the community cards. But the question might be rhetorical: "In a poker game, who has the most cards?" The answer: Everyone has the same number of cards, except the dealer deals them. So the answer: All players have the same number of cards. Or if you consider the community cards, the board has five cards. So the board has more than any individual player. So the answer: The board (community cards) has the most.
